name: UPSC
exam: All UPSC examinations (checked against Civil Services Examination, 2026)

source.title: Instructions for uploading documents (upsconline.nic.in, Instructions and FAQs)

uploads.label: Photograph
rules: Frontal view of the full face, head in the centre, both ears visible.
Eyes open and not covered by hair; no dark or coloured glasses.
No shadows on the face or background.
The photograph must not be signed.

uploads.label: Signature (three times)
rules: Sign three times, one below the other, with a gap between each.
Black ink on plain white paper with no lines or colours.
Scan all three signatures as a single image, upright and not rotated.
The image must be clear, sharp and well lit.
conflicts: "350 - 500 pixels" does not say whether it applies to width, height or both.

uploads.label: Photo ID (Aadhaar or other photo ID)
Name change affidavit or gazette notification

notes: File names are enforced: the portal refuses a document with any other name, format or size.
A live photograph is also captured in the form and matched against the uploaded photo; a mismatch stops the application.
Photo and signature rules are also in "Instructions for uploading the photo & signature" on the same portal, which gives the same figures.
The portal links contain build hashes and break when the portal is rebuilt. Find them again at upsconline.nic.in under Instructions and FAQs.
EPFO examination uploads (bachelor's marksheet and degree, scribe photo and signature, and others) are not included.
